'''Hollastin''' was a busy [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]. At one point, the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] experienced an instance of good fortune there. Hollastin emerged unscathed from the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of Hutt Space and subsequently rose in importance.

==Description==
Hollastin was a small [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Hollastin system/Legends|Hollastin system]] of [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It was situated between the worlds [[Affavan]] and [[Aylayl]] on the [[Hollastin Run/Legends|Hollastin Run]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]], while the route known as the [[Pando Spur/Legends|Pando Spur]] linked it to the planet [[Xolu]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding Hollastin was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]] and [[8000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the planet fell within the territory in which the [[Thirteenth Army|Thirteenth Sector Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was tasked with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Hollastin, along with the rest of Hutt Space, had become a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" />

The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] experienced an unexpected instance of good fortune at Hollastin at some point between [[14 BBY/Legends|14 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Between [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], when the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] attacked Hutt Space as part of its [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the invaders also [[Attack on the Hollastin system|captured]] the Hollastin [[Star system/Legends|system]], keeping it under their control until at least 27 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]. Hollastin, however, emerged from the conflict unscathed and subsequently saw a significant increase in its importance as a [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] world.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
Hollastin was a thriving trade world controlled by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] species, serving as a clearinghouse for cargos being transported into Hutt Space. Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the population of the Hollastin system numbered between 500 million and one billion.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hollastin was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square S-12.<ref name="TEA" />
